raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: momentum
  version: "0.1.114"
  build_number: 3

recipe:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/facebookresearch/momentum/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: e0fda8cd38cee74a4cbb581212e4ff015814c58eba83b21e51a560f3399a476b
    patches:
      - patches/0001-undef-windows-near-far.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}

outputs:
  - package:
      name: momentum-cpp
    build:
      skip:
        - cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      script:
        file: ${{ "bld_cpp.bat" if win else "build_cpp.sh" }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
      host:
        - ceres-solver * cpu*
        - cli11
        - dispenso
        - drjit-cpp * cpu*
        # Momentum 0.1.111 requires Eigen 5.0.x.
        - eigen >=5.0,<5.1
        - ezc3d
        - fmt
        - fx-gltf
        - indicators
        - librerun-sdk
        - mdspan >=0.6.1.dev20260223
        - ms-gsl
        - nlohmann_json
        - openfbx
        - if: linux
          then:
            - openusd
            - python
        - re2
        - spdlog
        # OpenUSD 26.08 still uses the legacy tbb::task API removed in TBB 2023.1.
        - if: not win
          then: tbb-devel <2023.1
